The engine block and cylinder head are heavily soiled with grease and grime.
A red 'TOKUNBO' sticker is visible on the top of the cylinder head.
The engine is missing the intake manifold and the radiator hoses.
The engine is resting on a wooden pallet or crate.
A pair of black gloves is visible on a shelf in the background.

risks.risk: The engine may have internal mechanical damage (cracks, worn pistons, seized rods) not visible in the static photo.
risks.proof: A video of the engine being started and running through a compression test.

risks.risk: The engine may be missing critical components like the timing belt, water pump, or alternator.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine bay with all components visible.

risks.risk: The engine may have seized or burnt valves.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine with the valve cover removed showing the valve train.

proof_requests: Photo of the engine bay showing the intake manifold, radiator hoses, and all other components.
Video of the engine being started and running.
Photo of the engine with the valve cover removed.
Photo of the engine identification plate (VIN/serial number).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
